_comment: Pinned presence program for the single-goal (hero) clip, authored for the eval harness presence cell (D1 presence caveat). Hits the detect -> answer existence op-path (op_answer dispatches on the `detections` binding kind and grounds Yes when any are found). Window 4000-5000ms @ fps8 covers the single legible analyzed frame (4625) in hero_cache.json, so detect finds 5 person boxes and the existence answer grounds to 'Yes'. end_ms 5000 <= clip duration_ms 5067. Validates against ../schema/dsl.schema.json. Ground truth ('Yes') is derived by executing this program over hero_cache.json, never hand-typed.
